title.purpose: Application identity and analytical workspace headings.

label.purpose: Navigation, selectors and dense table context.

components.name: Primary Detection Button
components.description: The single strong action used to start interaction detection.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background:#071A2E; color:#fff; border:1px solid #071A2E; border-radius:4px; padding:7px 11px; font:700 12px Aptos,Segoe UI,sans-serif; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:#123654; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #0072B2; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Secondary Action
components.description: Compact file, comparison and export actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background:#fff; color:#172733; border:1px solid #AEBBC4; border-radius:4px; padding:7px 11px; font:400 12px Aptos,Segoe UI,sans-serif; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background:#D8E0E5; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #0072B2; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Profile Selector
components.description: Keeps Complete and Discovery Studio-like analysis visible.
components.css: .ds-field-label { color:#142330; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; font:600 11px Aptos,Segoe UI,sans-serif; } .ds-field { background:#fff; color:#142330; border:1px solid #AEBBC4; border-radius:4px; padding:5px 7px; font:400 12px Aptos,Segoe UI,sans-serif; } .ds-field:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #0072B2; outline-offset:1px; }

components.name: Workspace Navigation
components.description: Deep-navy peer-workspace rail with one active selection.
components.css: .ds-nav { width:150px; padding:16px 8px; background:#071A2E; display:grid; gap:6px; } .ds-nav button { background:transparent; color:#DCE7EE; border:0; border-radius:3px; padding:10px 12px; text-align:left; font:600 12px Aptos,Segoe UI,sans-serif; } .ds-nav button:hover { background:#102E49; color:#fff; } .ds-nav button.is-active { background:#0072B2; color:#fff; } .ds-nav button:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #fff; outline-offset:1px; }

components.name: DockLens Lens
components.description: Persistent evidence inspector synchronized to the selected residue.
components.css: .ds-lens { width:260px; background:#fff; color:#142330; border-left:1px solid #D8E0E5; padding:18px 16px; font:400 12px Aptos,Segoe UI,sans-serif; } .ds-lens h3 { margin:0 0 18px; font-size:14px; } .ds-lens strong { display:block; font-size:20px; margin-bottom:12px; } .ds-lens small { display:block; background:#EDF3F6; border:1px solid #CAD7DE; border-radius:3px; color:#294151; padding:7px 10px; }

narrative.overview: DockLens feels like a contemporary structural-biology instrument: precise enough for dense scientific evidence, calm enough for long analysis sessions, and organized around residues, interaction channels and temporal states.
keyCharacteristics: Restrained analytical surfaces with one strong navigational accent.
Okabe-Ito interaction colors used only as scientific category semantics.
Wide data viewports, compact controls and a persistent contextual inspector.
Crisp plot fields, restrained contours and sparse depth.
Familiar desktop behavior with high-DPI and compact-screen adaptation.

rules.name: The Semantic Color Rule
rules.body: Interaction colors never decorate containers, navigation or headings; they identify interaction evidence only.

rules.name: The Single Focus Rule
rules.body: Primary accent marks the current task, selection and keyboard focus, never multiple competing calls to action.

rules.name: The Data Owns the Viewport Rule
rules.body: Controls frame the evidence; they do not consume the area required to compare residues, poses or frames.

dos: Do keep filters, charts and tables synchronized through the DockLens Lens.
Do label docking frequency and molecular-dynamics occupancy distinctly.
Do expose the counting unit and denominator beside every aggregate chart.
Do preserve the Discovery Studio-like profile as a visible analytical choice with its parameters available for audit.
Do export the data and parameters behind every figure.
donts: Don't use interaction colors as general UI decoration.
Don't hide raw evidence behind a composite score.
Don't place every analysis inside identical cards.
Don't rely on hover for essential scientific information.
Don't imply that docking poses are temporal observations.
